steps.label: build
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/euv/"* . && rm -f screen.jpg && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P euv.py -- save > b1.log 2>&1 && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b euv.blend -P euv_render.py -- stills 100 184 > s1.log 2>&1 && cp s/f0184.jpg screen.jpg && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P euv.py -- save > b2.log 2>&1 && grep -a 'EUV SAVED' b2.log | cut -c1-300 && ls -l euv.blend
